description: Sage is a virtual Mythic agent that that uses an AI agentic system to operate Mythic and Mythic agents running on compromised hosts.

written.description: Installs into a Mythic C2 server and operates it from the inside, reasoning over the live callbacks and the BloodHound graph to issue Mythic tasks. It never touches the target itself.

alive.last_commit_message:
Stop two payload-handoff wall-limit tests from flaking under load

Both tests drive the handoff case until a provider call is hanging, then
check that hitting the time limit while that call is in flight is reported
as a wall-time stop with uncertain usage. They set the limit to about a
second and assumed the call was dispatched before it fired. On a busy
runner the setup and seed replay can take longer than that, so the limit
fired before the call was in flight: the transport rejected it at the
deadline check before recording it, and the result then carried neither
the in-flight request nor the uncertainty flag the tests expect. They
passed on a fast machine and failed in CI.

Drive the stop off the call actually being in flight instead of racing a
one-second budget against setup. The limit is now generous, and each test
trips the deadline the moment its provider is entered, which the transport
reaches only after it has recorded the request. The behavior each test
asserts is unchanged; only the trigger is made deterministic. This touches
test code alone.
